races.paceDynamic: Hitak, Minella Supreme, and Kamino Bello will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with Claude also likely to press forward early. This strong pace over 2m3½f on yielding ground will create a proper stamina test, stretching the field and leaving plenty to do for hold-up horses turning for home. The combination of honest pace-setters and the testing conditions will favor horses that can travel prominently and sustain their effort, rather than those relying on late kicks. This race shape clearly favors prominent runners and those with proven stamina at the trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Travellers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters maintain honest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will suit horses positioned handy who can quicken when others tire. Hold-up horses will find too much to do against the testing pace and yielding ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong and burns out the leaders
scenarios.body: Patient riders can capitalize as the front-runners weaken, with fresher horses coming through late. The 2m3½f trip allows time for recovery if positioned well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace-Setter Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders finds the perfect rhythm and kicks clear
scenarios.body: Claude or Kamino Bello could dictate throughout and have enough left to resist late challengers. The yielding ground may favor their sustained galloping style over sharp finishers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or jumping errors disrupt the favorites
scenarios.body: Lower-rated horses like El Champo or Moon Mission could exploit a messy race. The large field creates opportunities for unfancied runners to slip through gaps.

races.paceDynamic: L'Evangeliste, Raise You Up, and Dunleer Crystal will set a strong gallop from the start, with L'Evangeliste the most proven front-runner having won three times leading. The fierce early pace will stretch the field significantly over this stamina-testing trip on yielding ground. Six horses wanting prominent positions (Los Blanco, Grey Jude, Green Angel, Vitorio Piel, Ifallgoeswell, Simply Natural) will create heavy traffic and tactical complications approaching the business end. This aggressive pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early burn-up and finish powerfully when others weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If L'Evangeliste and Raise You Up go too hard early in testing conditions
scenarios.body: The leaders will tie up badly in the final half-mile, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past a weakening field. Fresh closers with stamina reserves will dominate the finish as prominent runners fade dramatically.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is more measured with leaders showing restraint
scenarios.body: Prominent racers can stay in contention longer, creating a bunched finish where class and recent form become decisive factors. The better-rated horses tracking the pace can kick clear without the leaders completely collapsing.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If L'Evangeliste gets controlled fractions and sees off challenges
scenarios.body: The proven leader can dictate terms and maintain enough energy for a gutsy staying performance on suitable ground. His superior front-running experience allows him to judge pace better than his rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Compromised Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If early falls or interference disrupt the natural pace flow
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair where positioning luck trumps natural ability, favouring versatile horses who can adapt quickly. Opportunistic riders can steal a march when the expected pace-setters are hampered.

races.paceDynamic: Soir De Garde and Le Grand Peinture will set the tempo from the front, with both confirmed leaders likely to press each other through the early stages. races.paceDynamic: Kiltybo, Latosca Du Houx, Glens Anthem, Tintara and Celestial Tune will ensure a relentless gallop from the start in this competitive mares' race. The presence of five natural leaders guarantees a strong early pace that will steadily burn off over 2m4f, with the tempo likely sustained throughout rather than stop-start. This searching gallop will find out stamina reserves and tactical positioning becomes crucial in the final half-mile. Hold-up horses with proven stamina will benefit most from this pace scenario, as the early speed will set up a finishing kick for those with the class to quicken off a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the five front runners maintain their natural aggressive styles and create sustained pressure throughout
scenarios.body: The relentless pace will exhaust the speed horses and set up perfectly for proven finishers like Even Tho and Belladaball who thrive when able to unleash late kicks. Quality hold-up performers with the class to quicken off a true gallop will have ideal conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets first run and the hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the sustained tempo
scenarios.body: Latosca Du Houx or Glens Anthem could dictate on their own terms if the closers leave too much to do against the searching pace. The Mullins pair have both won when allowed controlled leads recently.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early and becomes stop-start, turning into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Prominent racers like Born Believing and Some Pretender would benefit from a more tactical affair that plays to their ability to sit handy and quicken. Without the strong gallop to tire the speed, positioning becomes everything.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the pace dynamics or ground conditions prove more testing than expected
scenarios.body: Treadonmydreams or Sapphire Jewel could benefit from a messy race where class doesn't tell and a horse that gets an uncontested run can spring a surprise. Pace pressure on favourites opens up opportunities.
